purpose: technical repeatability and historical discrepancy diagnosis; not algorithm selection
processes: fresh process per run, sequential, same Python executable and inherited environment
source_requirement: clean committed tree; full commit and actual source SHA-256 recorded
repeat_acceptance: identical full config, provenance identity, and exact bytes of summary, events, series, final density and positions; artifact integrity verified
historical_limits: AFTERFIX adaptive source was dirty, versions and events unavailable; belief reference predates revision and config hashes must be checked
invalid_run_policy: any process failure, provenance change, missing artifact, integrity mismatch or differing repeat fails control; retain all outputs; no selective exclusions or silent replacement
stop_reason_policy: compare exactly; unexpected time-budget stop is retained and investigated, never silently excluded
seed_status: 300-301 are already inspected development seeds; no final holdout seeds used
historical_policy: original CSV immutable and diagnostic; current repeatability does not identify historical cause
